findings.issue: Tone inverted. يا للهول is dread ('how awful'), but the two sibling lines in this namespace are 'You have recovered so many Ova.' and 'So many more than was foretold.' — the cultist is delighted, not horrified.

findings.source_en: It is a wonder… to see these Ova.
findings.ar: إنها عجيبة… أن أرى هذه البُيوض.
findings.issue: إنها has no antecedent and then a masculine أن-clause is supplied as its subject, so the sentence does not agree with itself. The English 'It is' is a dummy subject Arabic does not carry over.

In this scene Ruk is pushing the Harbinger to act on the spoiling egg ('Come! Look.' … 'this is what you were hatched for.'), so 'Go on' is encouragement to proceed, not 'carry on talking', which is what تابع says.
